title: Certified Execution Harness for Agentic AI: Safe and Least-Intrusive Petri-Net Supervisory Control Between Reasoning and Action
title_zh: 面向智能体AI的认证执行套件：推理与行动之间安全且最小侵入的Petri网监督控制

paragraphs.en: This paper studies the problem of safe tool execution for large language model (LLM) agents under prompt injection. Using Petri nets, we formalize the execution harness between the LLM and its tools as a supervisory control problem, in which marks represent capabilities, approvals and budgets. Since a transition fires only if the marks it needs are present, an injected request whose preconditions are unmet or already spent is refused regardless of its wording. Treating tool outcomes as uncontrollable, we enforce safety by the conventional maximally permissive supervisor, and this safety transfers to the running system under four assumptions. Moreover, to capture an agent that may propose again after a refusal, we introduce the notion of a replanning closed loop , in which each retry costs an inference call. We show that, in this loop, the conventional supervisor can be arbitrarily more intrusive than a stricter safe one. Furthermore, for a given proposer model, the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor is characterized as a value-threshold refinement of the conventional one. Under precise conditions, this refinement orders two concurrent actions by at most one monitor place. On an autonomous release agent, we find by synthesis that safe deployment requires a step that the supervisor can refuse after a rollout starts.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究提示词注入下大语言模型（LLM）智能体的安全工具执行问题。 我们使用 Petri 网将 LLM 与其工具之间的执行框架形式化为一个监督控制问题，其中标识表示能力、批准与预算。 由于只有当其所需标识存在时变迁才会发生，对于前置条件未满足或已被消耗的注入请求，无论其措辞如何都会被拒绝。 我们将工具结果视为不可控的，通过常规的最大许可监督器来实施安全性，并在四个假设下该安全性可传递到运行中的系统。 此外，为了刻画可能在被拒绝后再次提议的智能体，我们引入了重规划闭环的概念，其中每次重试都消耗一次推理调用。 我们证明，在此闭环中，常规监督器可能比更严格的安全监督器任意地更具侵入性。 进一步地，对于给定的提议模型，最大许可的最小侵入监督器被刻画为常规监督器的值阈值细化。 在精确条件下，这种细化至多通过一个监控库所对两个并发动作进行排序。 在一个自主发布智能体上，我们通过综合发现，安全部署需要一个在 rollout 开始后监督器可以拒绝的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Agentic AI systems use large language models (LLMs) to plan, call tools and exchange messages with other agents and with humans. Unlike an LLM that only writes text, an agent that calls tools can deploy a release, delete a file, leak a credential or spend a budget that cannot be recovered. Consider a release agent that plans a patch, runs tests and a security scan, obtains a human approval and deploys. Suppose that an instruction hidden in the issue description asks the agent to deploy immediately. Without an external check, the decision to deploy then relies solely on the LLM, which is the component that the injected instruction is designed to manipulate. If the LLM follows the instruction, the release goes live and cannot be undone. Such a premature deployment is an example of an operational failure, in which an action occurs out of order or more often than allowed. Other examples are an approval used twice and two agents holding one lock. In the latter case, both agents use a resource that only one may use at a time, such as a file or a deployment slot. In this paper, we address such operational failures. A credential leak, for example, is covered if it requires an action that the workflow does not permit at that point, but not if a permitted call carries the secret in its arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体化 AI 系统使用大型语言模型（LLM）来规划、调用工具，并与其他智能体和人类交换消息。 与只会撰写文本的 LLM 不同，会调用工具的智能体可以部署一个版本、删除一个文件、泄露一个凭证，或花掉一笔无法追回的预算。 考虑一个发布智能体，它会规划补丁、运行测试和安全扫描、获得人工批准并进行部署。 假设问题描述中隐藏了一条指令，要求该智能体立即部署。 在没有外部检查的情况下，部署决策便完全依赖 LLM，而 LLM 正是注入指令所要操纵的组件。 如果 LLM 遵循了该指令，发布就会上线且无法撤回。 这种过早的部署就是操作型失败的一个例子，即某个动作在错误的时机发生，或发生次数超过了允许的次数。 其他例子还有一次批准被使用了两次，以及两个智能体持有一把锁。 在后一种情况下，两个智能体都使用了同一时间只允许一个使用的资源，例如一个文件或一个部署槽位。 在本文中，我们解决这类操作型失败。 例如，凭证泄露如果需要工作流在该时点不允许的动作才能发生，就属于我们涵盖的范围；但如果一次被允许的调用在其参数中携带了密钥，则不属于。

paragraphs.en: Four common defenses have been used to protect LLM agents. First, a policy in the system prompt is text in the same context window that the attacker writes into. A rule such as “never deploy without approval” is thus only a request to the LLM. Second, a guardrail classifier asks a question about content, namely whether a message looks malicious. Third, access control decides who may act at all, and a permission, once granted, can usually be reused. Finally, sandboxing , which we take as a prerequisite, limits the damage that an action can cause. While these defenses are useful, none of them keeps track of the operational state, namely which actions have already occurred and what they have consumed. Stateful runtime enforcers , which are programs that check each action while the agent runs, do track such state, as do schemes that consume authorizations [ 1 ] . Nevertheless, they apply specified rules or a learned model [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] and do not use a supervisor synthesized to stay safe under uncontrollable outcomes. These are outcomes that cannot be refused, such as tool results and human decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 已有四种常见防御手段被用于保护 LLM 智能体。 第一种是系统提示词中的策略，它是攻击者可写入的同一上下文窗口中的文本。 因此，诸如「未经批准绝不部署」这样的规则对 LLM 而言只是一个请求。 第二种是护栏分类器，它针对内容提出一个问题，即某条消息看起来是否是恶意的。 第三种是访问控制，它决定谁根本可以执行操作，而权限一旦被授予，通常就可以被重复使用。 最后是沙箱，我们将其视为一个前提条件，它限制了某个操作可能造成的损害。 这些防御手段虽然有用，但它们都没有跟踪操作状态，即哪些操作已经发生以及它们消耗了什么。 有状态运行时强制器——即在智能体运行时检查每个操作的程序——确实会跟踪这类状态，消耗授权的方案也是如此 [ 1 ] 。 然而，它们应用的是预先设定的规则或学习得到的模型 [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] ，并不使用一个为在不可控结果下保持安全而专门合成的监督者。 这些结果是无法被拒绝的，例如工具返回的结果和人类的决策。

paragraphs.en: To decide whether an action may occur now, given what has already been spent, we start from the software around an LLM, which is called its harness or scaffold in agentic-AI practice [ 8 ] . This software executes the tool calls that the LLM proposes. Within it, we define a formal execution harness as the part that admits or refuses each proposed tool call. This execution harness makes such decisions without asking whether any content looks malicious. As shown in Fig. 1 , the LLM proposes a tool call, and an interface maps the proposal to a transition of a Petri net , which keeps track of the operational state. The net then decides whether this transition is enabled, while a supervisor , synthesized to stay safe under uncontrollable outcomes, decides whether it is permitted. The tool call will be executed only if, in addition, a validator accepts its arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 要在已知已经消耗了什么的前提下判断某个动作现在能否发生，我们从大语言模型（LLM）周围的软件出发，这类软件在智能体式人工智能实践中被称为 harness 或 scaffold [ 8 ] 。 该软件执行大语言模型提出的工具调用。 在其中，我们将形式化执行 harness 定义为对每个被提出的工具调用予以接受或拒绝的部分。 这个执行 harness 做出此类决策时并不询问任何内容是否看起来具有恶意。 如图 1 所示，大语言模型提出一个工具调用，一个接口将该提议映射为 Petri 网的一次迁移，该 Petri 网用于跟踪运行状态。 随后该网判断此迁移是否使能，而一个监督器——为在不可控结果下保持安全而合成——则判断该迁移是否被允许。 只有在此之外还有一个验证器接受其参数时，该工具调用才会被执行。

paragraphs.en: We adopt Petri nets to represent the operational state, since this state consists of resources that the actions of an agent produce and consume. For instance, an approval authorizes one deployment, and a tool call consumes one unit of budget. A Petri net represents such resources as marks * * * Called tokens in the Petri-net literature. We write marks to avoid confusion with LLM tokens, i.e., the basic units of text that LLMs process. in places and actions as transitions. The distribution of marks over the places, called the marking , is then the operational state. In this way, workflow rules become the structure of the net, while a policy in the system prompt states them only as instructions to the LLM. For example, the counting rule “the number of deployments never exceeds the number of approvals” becomes a linear inequality on firing counts. This inequality is enforced by one extra place that holds the unspent approvals, called a monitor place [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . The monitor place does so for any number of approvals and without enumerating states, but a finite automaton needs a bound fixed in advance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用Petri网来表示运行状态，因为这种状态由智能体的动作所产生和消耗的资源组成。 例如，一个批准授权一次部署，一次工具调用消耗一单位预算。 Petri网将这类资源表示为标记，* * * 在Petri网文献中称为令牌。 我们使用“标记”这一说法，以避免与LLM令牌（即LLM处理的基本文本单元）混淆。标记位于库所中，动作则对应变迁。 标记在各库所上的分布，称为标识，即为运行状态。 这样一来，工作流规则成为网的结构，而系统提示中的策略只是将其作为对LLM的指令来陈述。 例如，计数规则“部署次数绝不超过批准次数”就变成关于发生次数的线性不等式。 这个不等式由一个额外保存未用批准的库所来强制执行，该库所称为监视库所[9, 10, 11]。 监视库所对任意数量的批准都能做到这一点，且无需枚举状态，而有限自动机则需要预先固定的界限。

paragraphs.en: However, safety alone does not determine the design of the supervisor. In the conventional supervisory control of discrete-event systems, a disabled event does not occur, but an LLM agent receives a refusal as an error, and it may propose again [ 12 ] . Each such retry costs an inference call. Even when the supervisor keeps an injected instruction from causing an unsafe action, the instruction may still lead the agent to propose actions that are refused. In view of this, besides which actions the agent may take , it is also important to ask how much the supervisor hinders the agent , which we call the intrusiveness of the supervisor. Specifically, in this paper we count intrusiveness in refusals or in inference calls, and thus study which safe nonblocking supervisors hinder the agent least. Here, a supervisor is said to be nonblocking if a run under it can always be finished. Our contributions are threefold, as outlined below.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，安全性本身并不能决定监督器的设计。 在离散事件系统的传统监督控制中，被禁用的事件不会发生，但大语言模型智能体收到拒绝后会将其视为错误，并可能再次提出建议 [ 12 ]。 每次这样的重试都会产生一次推理调用开销。 即使监督器阻止了注入的指令导致不安全动作，该指令仍可能使智能体提出会被拒绝的动作。 有鉴于此，除了智能体可以采取哪些动作之外，同样重要的是追问监督器对智能体的妨碍程度有多大，我们将其称为监督器的侵入性。 具体而言，本文以拒绝次数或推理调用次数来度量侵入性，从而研究哪些安全的非阻塞监督器对智能体的妨碍最小。 这里，若一次运行在某监督器下总能执行完毕，则称该监督器是非阻塞的。 我们的贡献有三个方面，概述如下。

sents.en: However, safety alone does not determine the design of the supervisor.
sents.zh: 然而，安全性本身并不能决定监督器的设计。

sents.en: In the conventional supervisory control of discrete-event systems, a disabled event does not occur, but an LLM agent receives a refusal as an error, and it may propose again [ 12 ] .
sents.zh: 在离散事件系统的传统监督控制中，被禁用的事件不会发生，但大语言模型智能体收到拒绝后会将其视为错误，并可能再次提出建议 [ 12 ]。

sents.en: Each such retry costs an inference call.
sents.zh: 每次这样的重试都会产生一次推理调用开销。

sents.en: Here, a supervisor is said to be nonblocking if a run under it can always be finished.
sents.zh: 这里，若一次运行在某监督器下总能执行完毕，则称该监督器是非阻塞的。

paragraphs.en: First, we formalize the execution harness as a supervisory control problem on the agentic execution Petri net (AEPN) . In the AEPN, an admission rule fixes what the LLM may influence. Moreover, with consumable authorization, each approval or budget is a mark that a firing spends, so that rules against replay, reuse and out-of-order actions become linear inequalities. Safety is then enforced by a supervisor computed with the conventional Ramadge–Wonham supervisory control [ 13 , 14 ] . We also propose four assumptions under which this safety transfers to the running system. Specifically, these assumptions require that the net tracks the running system faithfully and that no action or event bypasses the execution harness.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们将执行框架形式化为智能体执行 Petri 网（AEPN）上的监督控制问题。 在 AEPN 中，准入规则确定了 LLM 可以影响的内容。 此外，通过可消耗授权，每次批准或预算都是一个触发所消耗的标记，从而使针对重放、复用和乱序动作的规则变为线性不等式。 随后，通过使用传统的 Ramadge–Wonham 监督控制 [13, 14] 计算出的监督器来实施安全性。 我们还提出了四个假设，在这些假设下，这种安全性可以传递到运行中的系统。 具体而言，这些假设要求该网忠实地跟踪运行中的系统，并且没有任何动作或事件绕过执行框架。

sents.zh: 首先，我们将执行框架形式化为智能体执行 Petri 网（AEPN）上的监督控制问题。

sents.en: Moreover, with consumable authorization, each approval or budget is a mark that a firing spends, so that rules against replay, reuse and out-of-order actions become linear inequalities.
sents.zh: 此外，通过可消耗授权，每次批准或预算都是一个触发所消耗的标记，从而使针对重放、复用和乱序动作的规则变为线性不等式。

sents.en: Safety is then enforced by a supervisor computed with the conventional Ramadge–Wonham supervisory control [ 13 , 14 ] .
sents.zh: 随后，通过使用传统的 Ramadge–Wonham 监督控制 [13, 14] 计算出的监督器来实施安全性。

sents.en: We also propose four assumptions under which this safety transfers to the running system.
sents.zh: 我们还提出了四个假设，在这些假设下，这种安全性可以传递到运行中的系统。

sents.en: Specifically, these assumptions require that the net tracks the running system faithfully and that no action or event bypasses the execution harness.
sents.zh: 具体而言，这些假设要求该网忠实地跟踪运行中的系统，并且没有任何动作或事件绕过执行框架。

paragraphs.en: Second, as the main technical contribution, we introduce the replanning closed loop , in which the agent may propose again after a refusal, at a cost. We show that in this loop, the conventional maximally permissive supervisor can be arbitrarily more intrusive than a stricter safe one. We further characterize the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor as a value-threshold refinement of the conventional one. This refinement is computed from a proposer model, i.e., an estimate of the probability that the agent proposes each action. Since the refinement only removes transitions from the conventional supervisor, it is safe even if this estimate is wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，作为主要技术贡献，我们提出了重规划闭环，其中智能体在被拒绝后可以以一定代价再次提出方案。 我们证明，在这一闭环中，传统的最大宽容监督器可能比更严格的安全监督器具有任意大的侵入性。 我们进一步将最大宽容的最小侵入监督器刻画为传统监督器的价值阈值细化。 该细化由提议者模型计算得出，即对智能体提出每个动作的概率的估计。 由于该细化仅从传统监督器中删除转移，即使该估计有误，它仍然是安全的。

sents.en: Second, as the main technical contribution, we introduce the replanning closed loop , in which the agent may propose again after a refusal, at a cost.
sents.zh: 其次，作为主要技术贡献，我们提出了重规划闭环，其中智能体在被拒绝后可以以一定代价再次提出方案。

sents.en: We show that in this loop, the conventional maximally permissive supervisor can be arbitrarily more intrusive than a stricter safe one.
sents.zh: 我们证明，在这一闭环中，传统的最大宽容监督器可能比更严格的安全监督器具有任意大的侵入性。

sents.en: We further characterize the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor as a value-threshold refinement of the conventional one.
sents.zh: 我们进一步将最大宽容的最小侵入监督器刻画为传统监督器的价值阈值细化。

sents.en: This refinement is computed from a proposer model, i.e., an estimate of the probability that the agent proposes each action.
sents.zh: 该细化由提议者模型计算得出，即对智能体提出每个动作的概率的估计。

sents.en: Since the refinement only removes transitions from the conventional supervisor, it is safe even if this estimate is wrong.
sents.zh: 由于该细化仅从传统监督器中删除转移，即使该估计有误，它仍然是安全的。

paragraphs.en: Third, for two actions that may run in either order, we give precise conditions under which this refinement either leaves their order free or fixes it by one monitor place. On an autonomous release agent, we find by synthesis that safe deployment requires a step that the supervisor can refuse after a rollout starts, since otherwise the release could go live after an incident has frozen releases. A two-phase rollout provides such a step. For an illustrative proposer that requests a premature deployment only after the tests, the refinement puts the security scan first if and only if such a request has probability above 43 / 60 43/60 .
paragraphs.zh: 第三，对于两个可能以任意顺序运行的动作，我们给出了精确的条件，说明这种精化在何种情况下使它们的顺序保持自由，或在何种情况下通过一个监控库所将其固定。 在一个自主发布智能体上，我们通过综合发现，安全的部署需要一个在滚动发布开始后监督者仍可拒绝的步骤，否则发布可能在事故冻结发布之后仍然上线。 两阶段滚动发布正好提供了这样一个步骤。 对于一个仅在测试之后才请求过早部署的示例性提议者，当且仅当此类请求的概率高于 43/60 时，精化会将安全扫描排在前面。

sents.en: Third, for two actions that may run in either order, we give precise conditions under which this refinement either leaves their order free or fixes it by one monitor place.
sents.zh: 第三，对于两个可能以任意顺序运行的动作，我们给出了精确的条件，说明这种精化在何种情况下使它们的顺序保持自由，或在何种情况下通过一个监控库所将其固定。

sents.en: On an autonomous release agent, we find by synthesis that safe deployment requires a step that the supervisor can refuse after a rollout starts, since otherwise the release could go live after an incident has frozen releases.
sents.zh: 在一个自主发布智能体上，我们通过综合发现，安全的部署需要一个在滚动发布开始后监督者仍可拒绝的步骤，否则发布可能在事故冻结发布之后仍然上线。

sents.en: A two-phase rollout provides such a step.
sents.zh: 两阶段滚动发布正好提供了这样一个步骤。

sents.en: For an illustrative proposer that requests a premature deployment only after the tests, the refinement puts the security scan first if and only if such a request has probability above 43 / 60 43/60 .
sents.zh: 对于一个仅在测试之后才请求过早部署的示例性提议者，当且仅当此类请求的概率高于 43/60 时，精化会将安全扫描排在前面。

paragraphs.en: We call the execution harness certified because its guarantees are proven and do not rely on testing. In particular, its safety holds on the net for every sequence of proposals and environment moves and, under the four assumptions above, also in the running system. Moreover, the least-intrusive refinement is optimal for a given proposer model, which can be checked independently of how the refinement was computed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将该执行框架称为“经过认证的”，因为它的保证是经过证明的，且不依赖于测试。 特别地，其安全性在网络上对每一个提议序列和环境动作序列都成立，并且在上述四个假设下，在运行系统中同样成立。 此外，最小侵入式细化对于给定的提议者模型是最优的，且这一点可以独立于细化的计算方式来检验。

sents.en: We call the execution harness certified because its guarantees are proven and do not rely on testing.
sents.zh: 我们将该执行框架称为“经过认证的”，因为它的保证是经过证明的，且不依赖于测试。

sents.en: In particular, its safety holds on the net for every sequence of proposals and environment moves and, under the four assumptions above, also in the running system.
sents.zh: 特别地，其安全性在网络上对每一个提议序列和环境动作序列都成立，并且在上述四个假设下，在运行系统中同样成立。

sents.en: Moreover, the least-intrusive refinement is optimal for a given proposer model, which can be checked independently of how the refinement was computed.
sents.zh: 此外，最小侵入式细化对于给定的提议者模型是最优的，且这一点可以独立于细化的计算方式来检验。

paragraphs.en: The rest of this paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work, while Section III recalls the basics of Petri nets and state-feedback supervisors. Section IV introduces the AEPN and its admission rule, derives the maximally permissive supervisor, and states the four assumptions under which safety transfers to the running system. Section V introduces the replanning closed loop and characterizes the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor, including how it orders concurrent actions. Section VI applies the safety and least-intrusiveness results to an autonomous release agent. Conclusions are drawn in Section VII .
paragraphs.zh: 本文其余部分的组织结构如下。 第二节回顾相关工作，第三节回顾 Petri 网与状态反馈监督器的基础知识。 第四节介绍 AEPN 及其准入规则，推导最大容忍监督器，并给出安全性能迁移到运行系统所需的四个假设。 第五节介绍重规划闭环，并刻画最大容忍最小侵入监督器，包括其如何对并发动作进行排序。 第六节将安全性与最小侵入性的结果应用于一个自主发布智能体。 第七节给出结论。

paragraphs.en: Supervisory control and related methods. Petri-net supervisory control with uncontrollable transitions [ 15 ] and monitor places for linear constraints [ 9 , 10 ] are well studied. Maximally permissive supervisors have been characterized for agent programs with uncontrollable actions [ 16 ] , and Petri nets have been proposed to organize agent workflows [ 17 ] . In supervisory control under attack [ 18 ] , the adversary corrupts the plant–supervisor channels (i.e., sensors and actuators). In this paper, however, the adversary acts on the proposer.
paragraphs.zh: 监督控制及相关方法。 带有不可控变迁的Petri网监督控制[ 15 ]以及用于线性约束的监控库所[ 9 , 10 ]已得到充分研究。 对于具有不可控动作的智能体程序，已经刻画了最大容许监督器[ 16 ]，并且已有研究提出用Petri网来组织智能体工作流[ 17 ]。 在受攻击下的监督控制[ 18 ]中，对手会破坏受控对象—监督器之间的信道（即传感器和执行器）。 然而，在本文中，攻击对象是提议者。

sents.en: Supervisory control and related methods.
sents.zh: 监督控制及相关方法。

paragraphs.en: Several other approaches incorporate costs or probabilities into supervisory control or modify unsafe actions. Optimal supervisory control [ 19 , 20 ] attaches external costs to events or states and to event disablement. Language-measure control [ 21 ] keeps the probability of a disabled event as a self-loop, while probabilistic discrete-event systems [ 22 , 23 ] renormalize probabilities over enabled events. Further, permissive controller synthesis [ 24 ] penalizes disallowed actions, and shields [ 25 ] mask or substitute unsafe actions. However, none of the approaches reviewed so far attaches a cost to the retries of an untrusted proposer while requiring safety for every sequence of proposals and environment moves. The closest of these is language-measure control, whose optimal supervisor disables a controllable transition if and only if its target has a smaller optimal measure than its source [ 21 ] . Similarly, when intrusiveness is counted in inference calls, the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor refuses a transition admitted by the conventional supervisor if and only if its target has a larger optimal expected cost than its source. In our setting, however, safety is a hard constraint and is not encoded as a negative state weight. Moreover, costs accumulate until the task ends, without any random termination.
paragraphs.zh: 其他若干方法将代价或概率纳入监督控制，或对不安全动作进行修改。 最优监督控制 [ 19 , 20 ] 为事件或状态以及事件的禁用附加外部代价。 语言测度控制 [ 21 ] 将被禁用事件的概率保留为自环，而概率离散事件系统 [ 22 , 23 ] 则在使能事件上重新归一化概率。 此外，容许控制器综合 [ 24 ] 对不允许的动作进行惩罚，而屏蔽器 [ 25 ] 会掩盖或替换不安全动作。 然而，目前为止综述的这些方法中，没有一个在要求对每一个提议与环境移动序列都保证安全的同时，为不可信提议者的重试附加代价。 其中最接近的是语言测度控制，其最优监督器当且仅当可控迁移的目标状态的最优测度小于其源状态时禁用该迁移 [ 21 ] 。 类似地，当侵入性以推理调用次数计算时，最大容许的最小侵入监督器当且仅当某迁移的目标状态的最优期望代价大于其源状态时，拒绝该被常规监督器所容许的迁移。 然而，在我们的设定中，安全性是一个硬约束，并不被编码为负的状态权重。 此外，代价持续累积直到任务结束，不存在任何随机终止。

paragraphs.en: Like safety filters, which minimally modify a nominal input at each instant [ 26 ] , and shields that interfere minimally [ 27 ] , the maximally permissive supervisor refuses as little as possible at each marking. Example 1 , however, shows that refusing as little as possible need not minimize intrusiveness. In optimal supervisory control, it is already known that cost-optimal supervisors may be stricter [ 19 , 20 ] . Compared with these works, the example gives a cost ratio that is unbounded over all proposers, where the cost of a refusal is the retry that it causes.

paragraphs.en: Harness-level defenses for LLM agents. CaMeL [ 28 ] separates control flow from untrusted data, while Progent [ 4 ] restricts tool privileges by symbolic policies that it updates during a run. AgentSpec [ 2 ] and ProbGuard [ 3 ] enforce user-specified rules and monitor a learned Markov chain at run time, respectively, possibly returning a violation to the agent. However, none of these four defenses models the consumption of authorizations, synthesizes a maximally permissive policy from a workflow model with uncontrollable events, or optimizes its interventions with respect to the retries that they cause. Although SafeHarness limits the invocations of a capability [ 29 ] and CapLease consumes authorizations [ 1 ] , neither of them relies on a net used for synthesis. In [ 12 ] , a gate whose blocking decisions affect later proposals is optimized under a constraint on the expected risk, at a cost for each compliant proposal that it blocks. Unlike this constraint, which bounds the risk in expectation, our safety guarantee holds for every sequence of proposals.
paragraphs.zh: 面向 LLM 智能体的框架级防御。 CaMeL [ 28 ] 将控制流与不可信数据分离，而 Progent [ 4 ] 通过在运行期间更新的符号化策略来限制工具权限。 AgentSpec [ 2 ] 和 ProbGuard [ 3 ] 分别强制执行用户指定的规则并在运行时监控一个学习到的马尔可夫链，可能会向智能体返回一次违规。 然而，这四种防御均未对授权的消耗进行建模，未从包含不可控事件的工作流模型中综合出最大程度宽松的策略，也未针对其干预所引发的重复尝试对干预进行优化。 尽管 SafeHarness 限制某项能力 [ 29 ] 的调用次数，CapLease 消耗授权 [ 1 ]，但二者都不依赖于用于综合的网络。 在 [ 12 ] 中，一个其阻断决策会影响后续提案的门控在期望风险的约束下被优化，且它每阻断一个合规提案都会付出代价。 与这种仅以期望形式约束风险的约束不同，我们的安全保证对每一段提案序列都成立。

paragraphs.en: This section formalizes the execution harness as a supervisory control problem on the AEPN. We first define the AEPN and the admission rule, and then introduce consumable authorization. Next, we derive the maximally permissive supervisor and relate the usual components of an agent harness to the AEPN. Finally, we give four assumptions under which safety transfers to the running system.
paragraphs.zh: 本节将执行框架形式化为AEPN上的监督控制问题。 我们首先定义AEPN与准入规则，然后引入可消耗授权。 接下来，我们推导最大允许的监督器，并将智能体框架的常见组件与AEPN关联起来。 最后，我们给出四个假设，在这些假设下安全性可以传递到运行中的系统。

sents.en: This section formalizes the execution harness as a supervisory control problem on the AEPN.
sents.zh: 本节将执行框架形式化为AEPN上的监督控制问题。

sents.en: We first define the AEPN and the admission rule, and then introduce consumable authorization.

sents.en: Next, we derive the maximally permissive supervisor and relate the usual components of an agent harness to the AEPN.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们推导最大允许的监督器，并将智能体框架的常见组件与AEPN关联起来。

sents.en: Finally, we give four assumptions under which safety transfers to the running system.
sents.zh: 最后，我们给出四个假设，在这些假设下安全性可以传递到运行中的系统。

paragraphs.en: We begin by separating the untrusted parts of the system from the trusted ones. As shown in Fig. 1 , the content that an agent reads (web pages, documents, tool results, peer messages) may be attacker-controlled, and the LLM is not assumed to resist it. Each tool call that the LLM proposes is therefore untrusted . In contrast, the interface with its validator, the Petri-net kernel holding the marking, the supervisor and a log of all proposals form the trusted computing base, namely the execution harness. When no confusion arises, we also call the whole execution harness the kernel. Next, we define the AEPN, which is the Petri net that the kernel holds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先将系统中不可信的部分与可信的部分分离开来。 如图 1 所示，智能体读取的内容（网页、文档、工具结果、对等消息）可能受攻击者控制，并且不假设大语言模型能够抵御这些内容。 因此，大语言模型提出的每次工具调用都是不可信的。 与之相对，接口及其验证器、保存标识的 Petri 网内核、监督器以及所有提案的日志构成了可信计算基，即执行框架。 在不会引起混淆的情况下，我们也把整个执行框架称为内核。 接下来，我们定义 AEPN，即内核所持有的 Petri 网。

paragraphs.en: An agentic execution Petri net is a tuple 𝒩 = ( P , T , A , Σ , κ , G , E , M 0 , ℓ , ω , χ ) \mathcal{N}=(P,T,A,\Sigma,\kappa,G,E,M_{0};\,\ell,\omega,\chi) whose first eight components form a colored Petri net [ 31 ] . These components are finite disjoint sets P P and T T of places and transitions, arcs A ⊆ ( P × T ) ∪ ( T × P ) A\subseteq(P\times T)\cup(T\times P) , a finite set Σ \Sigma of color sets, the color set κ ⁡ ( p ) ∈ Σ \kappa(p)\in\Sigma of each place p p , guards G G , arc expressions E E and an initial marking M 0 M_{0} . A marking assigns to each place p p a multiset of marks over κ ⁡ ( p ) \kappa(p) . A binding of a transition t t assigns a color to each variable of t t , and t t fires in a binding that satisfies its guard G ⁡ ( t ) G(t) , which is a condition on these variables. In each binding, the expression of an arc ( p , t ) (p,t) or ( t , p ) (t,p) evaluates to a multiset over κ ⁡ ( p ) \kappa(p) , whose multiplicities are the arc weights. The firing removes the multiset of each arc ( p , t ) (p,t) from p p and adds that of each arc ( t , p ) (t,p) to p p . The last three components label each t ∈ T t\in T with its action ℓ ⁡ ( t ) \ell(t) (a tool or message name), responsible principal ω ⁡ ( t ) \omega(t) (an agent, a human or the environment) and controllability χ ⁡ ( t ) ∈ { c , u } \chi(t)\in\{c,u\} , with c c for controllable and u u for uncontrollable.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体执行 Petri 网是一个元组 𝒩 = ( P , T , A , Σ , κ , G , E , M 0 , ℓ , ω , χ ) \mathcal{N}=(P,T,A,\Sigma,\kappa,G,E,M_{0};\,\ell,\omega,\chi) ，其前八个分量构成一个着色 Petri 网 [31]。 这些分量是库所和变迁的有限不相交集合 P P 和 T T 、弧 A ⊆ ( P × T ) ∪ ( T × P ) A\subseteq(P\times T)\cup(T\times P) 、颜色集的有限集合 Σ Σ 、每个库所 p p 的颜色集 κ ⁡ ( p ) ∈ Σ \kappa(p)\in\Sigma 、守卫 G G 、弧表达式 E E 以及初始标识 M 0 M_{0} 。 一个标识为每个库所 p p 指派一个定义在 κ ⁡ ( p ) \kappa(p) 上的标记多重集。 变迁 t t 的一个绑定为其每个变量指派一个颜色，t t 在满足其守卫 G ⁡ ( t ) G(t) （这是关于这些变量的一个条件）的绑定中发生。 在每个绑定中，弧 ( p , t ) (p,t) 或 ( t , p ) (t,p) 的表达式求值为一个定义在 κ ⁡ ( p ) \kappa(p) 上的多重集，其重数即为弧权。 发生时，每条弧 ( p , t ) (p,t) 的多重集从 p p 中移除，每条弧 ( t , p ) (t,p) 的多重集加入 p p 中。 最后三个分量为每个 t ∈ T t\in T 标注其动作 ℓ ⁡ ( t ) \ell(t) （工具或消息名称）、责任主体 ω ⁡ ( t ) \omega(t) （一个智能体、人类或环境）以及可控性 χ ⁡ ( t ) ∈ { c , u } \chi(t)\in\{c,u\} ，其中 c c 表示可控，u u 表示不可控。

paragraphs.en: In the AEPN of Definition 1 , a mark represents an operational fact (a capability, a piece of evidence, an approval, a unit of budget). Its color carries the metadata on which admission decisions depend, such as the digest (a cryptographic hash) of an approved artifact. Compared with a colored Petri net, the AEPN is the same except that it labels each transition with its action, responsible principal and controllability.

The net 𝒩 \mathcal{N} then unfolds into an equivalent uncolored Petri net [ 31 ] . With a slight abuse of notation, we again write 𝒩 = ( P , T , Pre , Post ) \mathcal{N}=(P,T,\mathrm{Pre},\mathrm{Post}) for the unfolded net, with initial marking M 0 M_{0} . Specifically, its places are the pairs ( p , c ) (p,c) of a colored place p p and a color c ∈ κ ⁡ ( p ) c\in\kappa(p) . Its transitions are the pairs ( t , b ) (t,b) of a colored transition t t and a binding b b of t t that satisfies G ⁡ ( t ) G(t) . The entry Pre ⁡ ( ( p , c ) , ( t , b ) ) \mathrm{Pre}((p,c),(t,b)) is the multiplicity of c c in the value of the expression of ( p , t ) (p,t) in b b , or 0 0 if ( p , t ) ∉ A (p,t)\notin A , and likewise for Post \mathrm{Post} . Each transition inherits the labels ℓ \ell , ω \omega and χ \chi of its colored transition.

paragraphs.en: The outcome of an admitted call returns both to the kernel and to the context. In the kernel, this outcome is the firing of the uncontrollable transition t res ∈ T u t_{\mathrm{res}}\in T_{u} , named for the result of the call, while in the context it is untrusted content. More generally, the kernel fires an uncontrollable transition when it observes the corresponding external event, such as a tool outcome or a human decision. If an observed event matches no enabled uncontrollable transition, the kernel halts admission and escalates the event to a human, as discussed below.
paragraphs.zh: 被接纳调用的结果既返回给内核，也返回给上下文。 在内核中，该结果对应不可控变迁 t res ∈ T u t_{\mathrm{res}}\in T_{u} 的触发（以调用的结果命名），而在上下文中它是不可信内容。 更一般地，当内核观察到相应的外部事件（例如工具结果或人类决策）时，它会触发一个不可控变迁。 如果观察到的事件与任何已使能的不可控变迁都不匹配，内核将停止接纳过程，并将该事件升级给人类处理，如下文所述。

sents.zh: 更一般地，当内核观察到相应的外部事件（例如工具结果或人类决策）时，它会触发一个不可控变迁。

sents.en: If an observed event matches no enabled uncontrollable transition, the kernel halts admission and escalates the event to a human, as discussed below.
sents.zh: 如果观察到的事件与任何已使能的不可控变迁都不匹配，内核将停止接纳过程，并将该事件升级给人类处理，如下文所述。

paragraphs.en: We remark that the guarantee developed below concerns operational state, namely which consequential actions occur, in which order and how often. The net and the supervisor do not decide whether the arguments of an enabled action are malicious. For instance, an action may carry a patch with a backdoor or a recipient chosen by the attacker. This decision on the arguments is left to the validator V V , which we do not analyze, and to the checks that the workflow itself models, such as tests and human review. Data leaks through permitted actions and approval laundering (a human approving a malicious artifact) lie outside the guarantee. In particular, an injected request that passes all four checks of Eq. ( 1 ) is admitted regardless of its intent. The execution harness does not prevent jailbreaks or keep the LLM from being hijacked. Nevertheless, it bounds what a hijacked agent can do by what the net and the supervisor allow at the current marking.
paragraphs.zh: 我们指出，下文所建立的保证关注的是运行状态，即哪些后果性动作会发生、以何种顺序发生以及发生的频率如何。 网与监督者不判定某个已启用动作的参数是否为恶意。 例如，某个动作可能携带带有后门的补丁，或携带由攻击者选定的接收者。 关于参数的这一判定留给验证器 V V（我们并不对其进行分析），也留给工作流自身建模的检查，例如测试与人工审查。 通过被允许的动作造成的数据泄露以及审批洗白（由人工批准恶意产物）不在该保证范围之内。 特别地，一条通过了式 ( 1 ) 中全部四项检查的注入请求，无论其意图如何都会被放行。 该执行框架并不能防止越狱，也不能防止大语言模型被劫持。 尽管如此，它将被劫持的智能体能做的事情限制在当前标识下网与监督者所允许的范围之内。

paragraphs.en: In this subsection, we introduce consumable authorization, in which an approval or a budget is a mark that a firing spends. For each precondition of a transition, the modeler decides whether it is spent or tested . A tested condition of a transition t t is a place p p on a self-loop with t t , i.e., p ∈ ∙ t ∩ t ∙ p\in{}^{\bullet}t\cap t^{\bullet} with Pre ⁡ ( p , t ) = Post ⁡ ( p , t ) \mathrm{Pre}(p,t)=\mathrm{Post}(p,t) (Fig. 3 b). Such a condition still holds after the firing, since the firing returns the mark it tests. On the other hand, a spent condition of t t is a place p ∈ ∙ t ∖ t ∙ p\in{}^{\bullet}t\setminus t^{\bullet} . Each firing of t t then consumes Pre ⁡ ( p , t ) \mathrm{Pre}(p,t) marks of p p and returns none. Thus, two firings need twice as many marks, whether these marks are held initially or produced later.

paragraphs.en: This subsection derives the maximally permissive safe nonblocking supervisor on the AEPN, which can serve as the supervisor of the admission rule. The agent’s own tool calls, messages and memory writes are controllable, since the kernel may refuse (disable) them. However, tool outcomes, judgments, human decisions, incoming messages and incidents are not. The markings that exhibit an operational hazard form the forbidden-marking set ℬ \mathcal{B} . The terminal-marking set ℱ \mathcal{F} includes the markings of a completed task and those where the agent stops without acting (abstention) or hands the task to a human (escalation). These outcomes will later be assigned a terminal cost. Based on these sets, we compute the supervisor in two steps.
paragraphs.zh: 本小节推导AEPN上最大容许的安全非阻塞监督器，该监督器可作为准入规则的监督器。 智能体自身的工具调用、消息和内存写入是可控的，因为内核可以拒绝（禁用）它们。 然而，工具结果、判断、人类决策、传入消息和事件则不可控。 表现出运行危险的标识构成禁止标识集 ℬ \mathcal{B} 。 终止标识集 ℱ \mathcal{F} 包括已完成任务的标识，以及智能体停止而不采取行动（弃权）或将任务交给人类（升级）的标识。 这些结果稍后将被赋予终止代价。 基于这些集合，我们分两步计算监督器。

paragraphs.en: We relate seven common components of an agent harness (most of them also appear, under partly different names, in [ 33 ] ) to the AEPN in the following. The AEPN counterparts of the other five are held by the trusted execution harness.

paragraphs.en: Planning only proposes a tool call u k u_{k} , which the interface maps to a candidate transition t k t_{k} . Context management decides what the context window holds, i.e., the history H k H_{k} , which stays outside the net. Content enters the net only as a fired transition or as the color of a mark, such as the class of an email. Agent state corresponds to the marking M k M_{k} . Tools correspond to the transitions whose action ℓ ⁡ ( t ) \ell(t) names a tool, such as t call t_{\mathrm{call}} in Fig. 2 . Memory stores facts and text. A fact is kept as a mark, but text stays outside the net and, once recalled, is untrusted content. A memory write is a controllable transition, and a monitor place can serve as a write budget. Orchestration fixes the order of the actions and which agent or sub-agent performs each of them. It corresponds to the structure of the net together with the principals ω ⁡ ( t ) \omega(t) . For instance, one added monitor place can fix the order of two concurrent actions (Section V-D ). Governance corresponds to the supervisor together with the sets ℬ \mathcal{B} and ℱ \mathcal{F} of forbidden and terminal markings. Approvals and budgets are marks that firings spend (Section IV-B ).
paragraphs.zh: 规划仅提出一次工具调用 u k u_{k} ，由接口将其映射为候选迁移 t k t_{k} 。 上下文管理决定上下文窗口中保存什么内容，即历史 H k H_{k} ，它保持在网之外。 内容只有作为已触发的迁移或作为标记的颜色（例如邮件的类别）才进入网中。 智能体状态对应于标识 M k M_{k} 。 工具对应于动作 ℓ ⁡ ( t ) \ell(t) 将其命名为某个工具的迁移，例如图 2 中的 t call t_{\mathrm{call}} 。 记忆存储事实与文本。 事实以标记的形式保存，但文本保持在网之外，并且一旦被召回即被视为不可信内容。 一次记忆写入是一个可控迁移，而监控库所可以用作写入预算。 编排确定各动作的执行顺序，以及每个动作由哪个智能体或子智能体执行。 它对应于网的结构以及主体集合 ω ⁡ ( t ) \omega(t) 。 例如，添加一个监控库所就可以固定两个并发动作的执行顺序（第 V-D 节）。 治理对应于监督器以及禁止标识集 ℬ \mathcal{B} 和终止标识集 ℱ \mathcal{F} 。 审批与预算是标记在触发时被消耗的内容（第 IV-B 节）。

paragraphs.en: In this subsection, we relate the net to the running system and establish that safety transfers to it under four assumptions. The net is an abstract model of the running system, which is the deployed system that comprises the LLM, its harness, the tools and the services they reach. We describe the running system as a transition system 𝒳 = ( X , U , → 𝒳 , x 0 ) \mathcal{X}=(X,U,\to_{\mathcal{X}},x_{0}) with concrete , i.e., fully detailed, states X X (all data, files, credentials and messages), actions U U and steps x → 𝑢 𝒳 x ′ x\xrightarrow{u}_{\mathcal{X}}x^{\prime} . In its safe states X safe ⊆ X X_{\mathrm{safe}}\subseteq X , no unauthorized action has been executed.
paragraphs.zh: 在本小节中，我们将该网与运行中系统关联起来，并在四个假设下确立安全性可以传递到该系统。 该网是运行中系统的抽象模型，运行中系统即已部署的系统，包含大语言模型（LLM）、其脚手架、工具以及它们所访问的服务。 我们将运行中系统描述为一个转移系统 𝒳 = ( X , U , → 𝒳 , x 0 ) \mathcal{X}=(X,U,\to_{\mathcal{X}},x_{0}) ，其状态 X X 是具体的，即完全详尽的（包含所有数据、文件、凭证和消息），动作为 U U ，转移步为 x → 𝑢 𝒳 x ′ x\xrightarrow{u}_{\mathcal{X}}x^{\prime} 。 在其安全状态 X safe ⊆ X X_{\mathrm{safe}}\subseteq X 中，未执行过任何未经授权的动作。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 1 shows that a supervisor that is safe on the net also keeps the running system safe, as long as A1–A4 hold. We next discuss how these assumptions are met. A1 and A3 are met when the net is written, which is a modeling task that requires the net to record every operational fact on which safety depends. A4(a) is enforced by sandboxing and by credential brokering, in which only a trusted broker holds the credentials that the tools need. A2 is ensured by the interface and the Petri-net kernel, whichever supervisor is in use. In practice, the interface is the part most prone to error.
paragraphs.zh: 定理 1 表明，只要 A1–A4 成立，在网（net）上安全的监督器也能保证运行中的系统安全。 接下来我们讨论这些假设是如何满足的。 A1 和 A3 在网被编写时即已满足，这是一项建模任务，要求网记录安全性所依赖的每一个操作性事实。 A4(a) 通过沙箱和凭据代理来强制执行，即只有受信任的代理持有工具所需的凭据。 无论使用哪个监督器，A2 都由接口和 Petri 网内核来保证。 在实践中，接口是最容易出错的部分。

paragraphs.en: None of the four assumptions can be dropped, as the following five cases show. First, a system that violates only A1 can reach an unsafe state if its M 0 M_{0} holds an approval that no human gave. Second, a system that violates only A2 can do so if its interface maps a call that deletes the production database onto the transition for the staging one. Third, a system that violates only A3 can reach an unsafe state if its forbidden-marking set ℬ \mathcal{B} does not contain the markings of a credential leak. Fourth, a system that violates only A4(a) can do so if the agent calls the deployment service directly from a shell, which bypasses the kernel. Finally, a system that violates only A4(b) can reach an unsafe state if an incident freezes releases but is never fired in the kernel, so that the kernel will still admit a release.
paragraphs.zh: 以下五种情况表明，这四条假设缺一不可。 首先，仅违反 A1 的系统，若其 M 0 M_{0} 持有一份没有任何人类给予的批准，就可能进入不安全状态。 其次，仅违反 A2 的系统，若其接口把删除生产数据库的调用映射到对应预发布数据库的迁移上，也会如此。 第三，仅违反 A3 的系统，若其禁止标记集 ℬ \mathcal{B} 不包含凭据泄露对应的标记，就可能进入不安全状态。 第四，仅违反 A4(a) 的系统，若智能体绕过内核直接从 shell 调用部署服务，也会如此。 最后，仅违反 A4(b) 的系统，若某次事故冻结了发布却从未在内核中触发，内核就仍会允许该发布通过，从而进入不安全状态。

paragraphs.en: Unlike A4(a), A4(b) cannot be enforced by sandboxing. Instead, how A4(b) is met depends on the source of the event. First, the response to an admitted call returns to the execution harness, which executed the call (Fig. 2 ). Second, a human decision, such as an approval, can be made to take effect only through an authenticated interface of the kernel. In both cases, the kernel observes the event by construction. Third, any other event, such as an incident or the completion of a started rollout, must be reported to the kernel by its source over an authenticated channel. Moreover, if an observed event matches no transition of En u ​ ( M k ) \mathrm{En}_{u}(M_{k}) , the kernel will halt admission and escalate the event to a human, since the marking may no longer describe the system. An event that is never observed, however, cannot trigger this halt. An incident will not be reported late, since it still matches an enabled transition. Hence, every event of the third case that the net models must be reported before the kernel admits the next action. For instance, the kernel can query the source of a freeze before it admits a release.
paragraphs.zh: 与 A4(a) 不同，A4(b) 无法通过沙箱来强制执行。 相反，A4(b) 的满足方式取决于事件的来源。 首先，对已接纳调用的响应会返回到执行该调用的执行工具（图 2）。 其次，人类的决定（例如批准）可以规定只能通过内核的经过身份验证的接口才能生效。 在这两种情况下，内核在构造上都必然能观察到该事件。 第三，任何其他事件（例如事故或已启动的发布的完成）都必须由其来源通过经过身份验证的信道报告给内核。 此外，如果观察到的事件不与 En u ​ ( M k ) \mathrm{En}_{u}(M_{k}) 的任何变迁匹配，内核将停止接纳并将该事件上报给人类，因为标识可能已不再描述该系统。 然而，一个从未被观察到的事件无法触发这种停止。 事故不会被延迟报告，因为它仍然匹配某个已启用的变迁。 因此，网所建模的第三种情况的每个事件都必须在内核接纳下一个动作之前被报告。 例如，内核可以在接纳发布之前查询冻结的来源。

sents.en: Unlike A4(a), A4(b) cannot be enforced by sandboxing.
sents.zh: 与 A4(a) 不同，A4(b) 无法通过沙箱来强制执行。

sents.en: Instead, how A4(b) is met depends on the source of the event.
sents.zh: 相反，A4(b) 的满足方式取决于事件的来源。

sents.en: First, the response to an admitted call returns to the execution harness, which executed the call (Fig. 2 ).
sents.zh: 首先，对已接纳调用的响应会返回到执行该调用的执行工具（图 2）。

sents.en: Second, a human decision, such as an approval, can be made to take effect only through an authenticated interface of the kernel.
sents.zh: 其次，人类的决定（例如批准）可以规定只能通过内核的经过身份验证的接口才能生效。

sents.en: In both cases, the kernel observes the event by construction.
sents.zh: 在这两种情况下，内核在构造上都必然能观察到该事件。

sents.en: Third, any other event, such as an incident or the completion of a started rollout, must be reported to the kernel by its source over an authenticated channel.
sents.zh: 第三，任何其他事件（例如事故或已启动的发布的完成）都必须由其来源通过经过身份验证的信道报告给内核。

sents.en: Moreover, if an observed event matches no transition of En u ​ ( M k ) \mathrm{En}_{u}(M_{k}) , the kernel will halt admission and escalate the event to a human, since the marking may no longer describe the system.
sents.zh: 此外，如果观察到的事件不与 En u ​ ( M k ) \mathrm{En}_{u}(M_{k}) 的任何变迁匹配，内核将停止接纳并将该事件上报给人类，因为标识可能已不再描述该系统。

sents.en: An event that is never observed, however, cannot trigger this halt.
sents.zh: 然而，一个从未被观察到的事件无法触发这种停止。

sents.en: An incident will not be reported late, since it still matches an enabled transition.
sents.zh: 事故不会被延迟报告，因为它仍然匹配某个已启用的变迁。

sents.en: Hence, every event of the third case that the net models must be reported before the kernel admits the next action.
sents.zh: 因此，网所建模的第三种情况的每个事件都必须在内核接纳下一个动作之前被报告。

sents.en: For instance, the kernel can query the source of a freeze before it admits a release.
sents.zh: 例如，内核可以在接纳发布之前查询冻结的来源。

paragraphs.en: In addition, A2 imposes the following three requirements. First, the kernel must process admissions and event firings one at a time, so that each transition is checked and fired at the same marking, even when several agents propose concurrently. Second, an admitted action must take effect together with its firing in the kernel, with no external event in between. Third, the kernel must fire an event only after it has occurred.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，A2 施加以下三项要求。 首先，内核必须逐个处理准入与事件触发，使得每个迁移都在同一标记下被检查并触发，即使多个智能体同时提出提议。 其次，被准入的动作必须与其触发一起在内核中生效，其间不得有外部事件。 第三，内核只有在事件已经发生后才能触发该事件。

sents.en: In addition, A2 imposes the following three requirements.

sents.en: Second, an admitted action must take effect together with its firing in the kernel, with no external event in between.
sents.zh: 其次，被准入的动作必须与其触发一起在内核中生效，其间不得有外部事件。

sents.en: Third, the kernel must fire an event only after it has occurred.
sents.zh: 第三，内核只有在事件已经发生后才能触发该事件。

paragraphs.en: This subsection sets up the plant of the replanning closed loop, defines its cost, and derives the pattern value used below. paragraphs.en: We assume that the kernel hides γ \gamma from the agent, so that π \pi does not depend on it. An agent shown γ \gamma could propose within it, and π \pi would then depend on γ \gamma , although a hijacked agent may still propose outside it and be refused. Therefore, the cost model of this section, in which refusals measure intrusiveness, is valid only under this nondisclosure. Showing the agent a set that does not depend on γ \gamma , such as En c ​ ( M ) \mathrm{En}_{c}(M) , does not disclose γ \gamma and keeps this cost model valid.
paragraphs.zh: 我们假设内核对智能体隐藏 γ，因此 π 不依赖于 γ。 如果向智能体展示 γ，智能体可能会在其内提出提议，此时 π 就会依赖于 γ；尽管被劫持的智能体仍可能在 γ 之外提出提议并遭到拒绝。 因此，本节中用拒绝来衡量侵入程度的代价模型，仅在这种不披露的前提下才有效。 向智能体展示一个不依赖于 γ 的集合（例如 En_c(M)）不会泄露 γ，并使该代价模型保持有效。

paragraphs.en: This nondisclosure also limits what an attacker learns, since refusals are an information channel. For instance, an injected instruction can probe a protected action, infer protected information from its refusal, and leak it through a later permitted call [ 34 ] . If γ \gamma were disclosed, the attacker would learn immediately what refusals reveal one proposal at a time. Besides the stationary proposer and nondisclosure, the intrusiveness and termination results below rely on the following support and interleaving conditions.

paragraphs.en: Assumption Assumption B also relates nonblocking to termination. Consider a supervisor with admissible patterns. paragraphs.en: Since least-intrusive supervisors need not be unique, we compare them by the transitions that they admit, as in Proposition 1 . Specifically, a least-intrusive S ∈ 𝒮 S\in\mathcal{S} is called a maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor if every least-intrusive S ~ ∈ 𝒮 \tilde{S}\in\mathcal{S} satisfies γ S ~ ​ ( M ) ⊆ γ S ​ ( M ) \gamma_{\tilde{S}}(M)\subseteq\gamma_{S}(M) at every M ∈ R ⁡ ( S ~ / 𝒩 , M 0 ) ∖ ℱ M\in R(\tilde{S}/\mathcal{N},M_{0})\setminus\mathcal{F} . paragraphs.en: This subsection investigates the case where two actions may run in either order, such as the tests and the security scan of a patch. For such actions, Theorem 2 takes a closed form. Suppose that the agent tends to make a premature request after one of the two actions, as in the room of Example 1 . The refinement S J min S_{J_{\min}} may then let the other action run first, so that the marking where the agent makes this premature request is never reached. In the terminology of Remark 3 , such a choice of order is orchestration. The two actions may be two checks or the work of two sub-agents. Under conditions made precise below, the refinement S J min S_{J_{\min}} either leaves the order of the two actions free or fixes it by one monitor place.
paragraphs.zh: 本小节研究两个动作可能以任意顺序运行的情形，例如对一个补丁的测试与安全扫描。 对于这类动作，定理 2 具有封闭形式。 假设智能体倾向于在这两个动作之一之后发出过早请求，如示例 1 的房间中那样。 此时，细化 S J min S_{J_{\min}} 可能让另一个动作先运行，从而使智能体发出该过早请求的标识永远不会到达。 用注记 3 的术语来说，这种顺序的选择就是编排。 这两个动作可以是两项检查，也可以是两个子智能体的工作。 在下文精确给出的条件下，细化 S J min S_{J_{\min}} 或者让这两个动作的顺序保持自由，或者通过一个监视器库所将其固定。

As shown in Fig. 6 , a fork structure , or simply fork , consists of two controllable branches t 1 , t 2 ∈ T c t_{1},t_{2}\in T_{c} and a join transition. In a fork, each t i t_{i} has a single input place r i r_{i} and a single output place o i o_{i} , i.e., t i ∙ = { r i } {}^{\bullet}t_{i}=\{r_{i}\} and t i ∙ = { o i } t_{i}^{\bullet}=\{o_{i}\} . In addition, only t i t_{i} consumes r i r_{i} , and only the join consumes o i o_{i} .

paragraphs.en: In this section, we apply the safety and least-intrusiveness results developed above to the release agent. We first model the agent by a Petri net and synthesize its maximally permissive supervisor. We then study its least-intrusive supervisory control and test the admission rule against prompt injection.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将上文建立的安全性与最小侵入性结果应用于发布智能体。 我们首先将智能体建模为 Petri 网，并综合出其最大允许监督器。 然后我们研究其最小侵入监督控制，并针对提示注入测试准入规则。

paragraphs.en: To complete the model, we specify which transitions are uncontrollable. A controllability assignment is said to be honest if it treats the completion of a rollout as an uncontrollable outcome. Since a started rollout is completed by the deployment infrastructure without any action of the agent, the kernel cannot refuse its completion. Under the honest assignment, t finish t_{\mathrm{finish}} and t finish ​ _ ​ fr t_{\mathrm{finish\_fr}} thus join the freeze events, i.e., T u = { t incident , t thaw , t finish , t finish ​ _ ​ fr } T_{u}=\{t_{\mathrm{incident}},t_{\mathrm{thaw}},t_{\mathrm{finish}},t_{\mathrm{finish\_fr}}\} . The agent’s own calls and the actuators t start t_{\mathrm{start}} , t publish t_{\mathrm{publish}} , t publish ​ _ ​ fr t_{\mathrm{publish\_fr}} and t abort t_{\mathrm{abort}} are controllable. The judgment and the review are also outcomes, but they stay controllable in Table I .
paragraphs.zh: 为了完成该模型，我们需要指明哪些迁移是不可控的。 如果一个可控性指派将 rollout 的完成视为不可控结果，则称该指派是诚实的（honest）。 由于已启动的 rollout 是由部署基础设施完成、而无需智能体采取任何动作，因此内核无法拒绝其完成。 在诚实指派下，t finish t_{\mathrm{finish}} 与 t finish ​ _ ​ fr t_{\mathrm{finish\_fr}} 因此加入冻结事件集合，即 T u = { t incident , t thaw , t finish , t finish ​ _ ​ fr } T_{u}=\{t_{\mathrm{incident}},t_{\mathrm{thaw}},t_{\mathrm{finish}},t_{\mathrm{finish\_fr}}\} 。 智能体自身的调用以及执行器 t start t_{\mathrm{start}} 、t publish t_{\mathrm{publish}} 、t publish ​ _ ​ fr t_{\mathrm{publish\_fr}} 与 t abort t_{\mathrm{abort}} 是可控的。 判定与审查同样是结果，但在表 I 中它们仍保持可控。

sents.en: Since a started rollout is completed by the deployment infrastructure without any action of the agent, the kernel cannot refuse its completion.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we have formalized the execution harness of LLM agents as a supervisory control problem on a Petri net and shown that a supervisor that is safe on the net keeps the running system safe under four assumptions. Moreover, we have introduced the replanning closed loop, in which a refused agent may propose again at a cost. In this loop, the conventional maximally permissive supervisor can be arbitrarily more intrusive than a stricter safe one. For a given proposer model, the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor is characterized as a value-threshold refinement of the conventional one. Under precise conditions, this refinement orders two concurrent actions by at most one monitor place. On the release agent, we have found by synthesis that safe deployment requires a step that the supervisor can refuse after a rollout starts. In future work, we aim to bound the extra cost of an inaccurate proposer model and to loosen our assumption that it depends only on the current marking. Moreover, we plan to treat partial observation of the marking and to develop compositional synthesis for large nets.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们将大语言模型智能体的执行工具形式化为 Petri 网上的监督控制问题，并证明在四个假设下，在网络上安全的监督器能保证运行中的系统安全。 此外，我们引入了重规划闭环，其中被拒绝的智能体可以以一定代价再次提议。 在该闭环中，传统的最大宽容监督器可能比一个更严格的安全监督器具有任意更大的侵入性。 对于给定的提议者模型，最大宽容的最小侵入监督器被刻画为传统监督器的价值阈值细化。 在精确条件下，这种细化至多通过一个监控库所对两个并发动作进行排序。 在发布智能体上，我们通过综合发现，安全部署需要一个监督器可以在 rollout 开始后予以拒绝的步骤。 在未来工作中，我们旨在界定不准确的提议者模型带来的额外代价，并放宽其仅依赖于当前标识的假设。 此外，我们计划处理标识的部分可观测性，并针对大型网络开发组合式综合方法。

sents.zh: 在本文中，我们将大语言模型智能体的执行工具形式化为 Petri 网上的监督控制问题，并证明在四个假设下，在网络上安全的监督器能保证运行中的系统安全。

sents.en: Moreover, we have introduced the replanning closed loop, in which a refused agent may propose again at a cost.
sents.zh: 此外，我们引入了重规划闭环，其中被拒绝的智能体可以以一定代价再次提议。

sents.en: In this loop, the conventional maximally permissive supervisor can be arbitrarily more intrusive than a stricter safe one.
sents.zh: 在该闭环中，传统的最大宽容监督器可能比一个更严格的安全监督器具有任意更大的侵入性。

sents.en: For a given proposer model, the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor is characterized as a value-threshold refinement of the conventional one.
sents.zh: 对于给定的提议者模型，最大宽容的最小侵入监督器被刻画为传统监督器的价值阈值细化。

sents.en: Under precise conditions, this refinement orders two concurrent actions by at most one monitor place.
sents.zh: 在精确条件下，这种细化至多通过一个监控库所对两个并发动作进行排序。

sents.en: On the release agent, we have found by synthesis that safe deployment requires a step that the supervisor can refuse after a rollout starts.
sents.zh: 在发布智能体上，我们通过综合发现，安全部署需要一个监督器可以在 rollout 开始后予以拒绝的步骤。

sents.en: In future work, we aim to bound the extra cost of an inaccurate proposer model and to loosen our assumption that it depends only on the current marking.
sents.zh: 在未来工作中，我们旨在界定不准确的提议者模型带来的额外代价，并放宽其仅依赖于当前标识的假设。

sents.en: Moreover, we plan to treat partial observation of the marking and to develop compositional synthesis for large nets.
sents.zh: 此外，我们计划处理标识的部分可观测性，并针对大型网络开发组合式综合方法。
